_comment: WP-15 multi-stage boss goals (schema_version 1). Data says WHAT (phases, gate, parts); the code interprets HOW (FBossGoals.h) - no string condition DSL. Only the Ember Crypt mid slot is mapped for now; every other boss slot is unmapped and keeps the single-phase fallback (generation.boss_unit). A gated phase means: while any part lives the body's HP cannot drop below that phase's hp_above threshold (the Bone Hydra rule).
